$comment: Job templates of the insurance_loans business type (jobs contract section 5). DRAFT: every customer-facing text is for a native reader to check before it goes live. Written for insurance agents and loan agents (a BFSI business: the calling rules are stricter, so every message and call is for people who enquired or who said yes). The wording never promises approval, returns or a guarantee. No price, discount, delivery promise, refund promise or guarantee anywhere; templates are for enquirers and consenting customers only; the researcher template never calls or messages prospects (the owner reaches out personally). The invented prospects are fictional.
